recipe.visualDefinition: An extreme macro close-up of a human tongue, emphasizing wet, granular papillae texture, with a glossy red medicinal capsule resting horizontally in the lower third. The lighting is warm and directional, creating deep shadows in the oral cavity and high-specular highlights on the moist surfaces.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between organic, irregular tongue texture and smooth, synthetic capsule surface
Monochromatic warmth of flesh tones against the vibrant saturated red of the pill
Symmetry of the tongue's central groove bisecting the composition vertically
Scale distortion through extreme macro perspective
coreInvariants: Horizontal placement of the central object

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The tongue fills the entire frame; the capsule is centered horizontally in the lower foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The glossy red capsule acts as the primary focal point due to its color saturation and smooth finish.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top central groove of the tongue, move downward following the texture, and rest on the capsule and its integrated text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; limited to the dark corners of the mouth at the bottom edges.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm flesh tones (pinks, oranges, browns) providing the textural background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks in the shadows and corners for depth.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vivid crimson red for the capsule to draw immediate attention.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the red accent; medium saturation in the skin tones; high value contrast in the specular highlights.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: A mix of fluid script and condensed sans-serif block lettering.
letterConstructionRules: Primary title uses a connected, upright brush script
Secondary text uses a heavy, ultra-condensed sans-serif
Tertiary metadata uses a wide-tracked, small-scale sans-serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: Condensed letters have flat terminals and minimal spacing
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Script for elegance/fluidity paired with a rigid condensed sans-serif for impact and density.
graphicDevices: Horizontal capsule shape as a text container
Standardized warning label in the bottom right corner

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary fluid, upright script feel for the main title.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Impact or Agency FB Bold Condensed
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, narrow verticality of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a macro photograph of a moist, textured human tongue filling the frame, with a glossy, solid red medicinal capsule resting horizontally on the lower center. Use warm, dramatic lighting to emphasize the wet bumps of the tongue.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add white text centered on the capsule. Use a fluid script for the top line and a bold, ultra-condensed sans-serif for the bottom lines. Ensure the text follows the slight curve of the capsule's surface.

verificationChecks: Is the tongue texture visceral and wet?
Is the capsule a vibrant, glossy red?
Is the text white and centered on the capsule?
Is the lighting warm and directional?

mustAchieve: Realistic specular highlights on wet surfaces

postGenerationChecks: Check for realistic moisture/glisten on the tongue.
Ensure the capsule looks like a 3D object with proper highlights.
Verify the text is perfectly centered on the pill.
Confirm the color palette remains in the warm/red spectrum.
recipe.reuseFormula: Macro [Subject Texture] + [Geometric Object] + [Contrast Color Accent] + [Bi-style Typography Overlay]
